verdict.rationale: Calendly documents registrable webhook subscriptions that push payloads to your server endpoint in real time when invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule. Rescheduling fires both invitee.created and invitee.canceled. The webhook docs also cover full subscription management (create, list, delete), sample test data, signing keys for authenticity, and 24-hour exponential-backoff retries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time delivery reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, webhooks notify my systems in real time when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled
